decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed shop-front, due to its compatible design and appearance would not detract from the appearance of the parade of shops, the character of the locality or the street scene, and would improve disabled access to the premises, in accordance with policy ENV-B.1.1, S.4.2, S.4.4 and S.4.7 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and the Council's Think access Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 4 - The street number of the property shall be displayed on the fascia hereby approved.
description: Installation of new shopfront and cladding.
